comparison.objective: Bring two free plates edge-to-edge in midair with a controlled seam; candidate tunes a damper.
comparison.physical_skill: Bimanual pose coordination and sustained plate alignment versus counterholding a component while using a key and rotating a fine adjuster.
comparison.success_condition: Level, parallel plates with an 8–25 mm positive gap and no overlap versus stroke-, impact-, rebound-, overload-, and drift-limited cycles. Detailed pose thresholds beyond those listed and separate specs were not provided.
comparison.reason: The task tests coordinated free-body alignment rather than tool-mediated calibration.
